_comment: The owner's zero-tolerance list (§3) turned into machine-checkable assertions. Each check names the artefact it reads and the exact observable that fails it. A check that cannot be evaluated is BLOCKED, never silently passed.

checks.fails_when: a row carries a person name, email address or phone number that does not appear verbatim in a grade A or B artefact cited by that same row

checks.owner_clause: treating snippets as verified original sources
checks.fails_when: any accepted row has source_grade E, or cites no retrieved page

checks.owner_clause: persisted challenge/login page as validated evidence
checks.fails_when: a stored artefact whose bytes match the challenge markers in the crawl guard is cited by an accepted row, or is labelled validated

checks.reads: egress decision log + artefact origin URLs
checks.fails_when: any retrieval targeted a domain outside the brief's allowance, or a private/loopback/metadata address was contacted
a provider call exists in the receipt stream with no matching ledger row, or a ledger row exists with no receipt
a dispatched operation is neither settled nor held as UNKNOWN after the run ends
one operation signature maps to more than one dispatched-and-charged attempt
any non-GET request, form submission, email send, message send or account mutation was issued
a cited artefact's stored bytes do not hash to the recorded sha256, or the lineage chain has a missing parent

checks.reads: every artefact, receipt, log and transcript shipped for review
checks.fails_when: any provider key value, token, cookie, private key or wallet-identifying metadata appears; also fails on a key's hash or length being recorded

checks.owner_clause: the brief is not edited to fit the result
checks.reads: research-brief.json at the exact SHA the run started from
checks.fails_when: the brief used by the run differs from the brief committed before the run began
a row carries any personal data of a named individual beyond a public role title published on a grade A or B page

evaluation_rule: Every check is evaluated on the run's artefacts. A check with no readable artefact is BLOCKED with the artefact named in the excuse, and a BLOCKED check prevents a PASS verdict for the run.
verdict_rule: Any P0 failure ⇒ the run's quality verdict is FAIL regardless of every other measurement.
